dedupe_keys.name: reseaux en fibre optique jusqu a l abonne ftth par departements

description: Réseaux en fibre optique jusqu'à l'abonné (FTTH par Départements) is a dataset listed in Portail Open Data de La Réunion, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Arcep. Suivi des déploiements sur le marché du haut et très haut débit fixes dans les départements de France - 3ème trimestre 2022 (issu de la collecte trimestrielle "Observatoire de gros HD/THD" au titre de la décision n°2012-1503 de l'ARCEP). Coverage: La Réunion. The portal files it under Aménagement durable du territoire. Its keywords are couverture fibre, ftth, thd. The portal shows 104 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-01-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-regionreunion-com-portal.
